headlines.description: — Jalen Brunson had just finished the highest-scoring game of his playoff career, the highest ever by a New York Knicks player in the postseason, and he was impressed.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brunson scores career playoff-high 47 points, leads Knicks over 76ers for 3-1 lead
